name: Meta-Level CI/CD Execution Engine
description: Self-composing CI/CD engine built entirely from activity templates

tasks.description: Determine what changed and what needs to run

prompt.template:
Search for activities to analyze git changes:
search_activities({ category: 'infrastructure', verbose: true })

Look for templates like:
- 'analyze-git-diff'
- 'detect-affected-services'
- 'determine-test-scope'

Execute the best match with:
- branch: {{branch}}
- baseBranch: {{baseBranch}}

This determines the CI/CD pipeline scope.

tasks.description: Build only the services that changed

prompt.template:
Based on the change analysis impulse, search for build activities:
search_activities({ category: 'infrastructure' })

Look for templates matching the affected services.

For each affected service:
  activity({
    templateId: '<build-template-id>',
    variables: {
      serviceName: '<service>',
      version: '{{version}}',
      buildEnv: '{{buildEnv}}'
    },
    reason: 'Building service affected by changes'
  })

This composes multiple build activities dynamically.

tasks.description: Execute appropriate test activities based on scope

prompt.template:
Search for test activities:
search_activities({ category: 'infrastructure' })

Based on change scope and build results:

If {{testScope}} == 'full':
  - Run: 'run-full-test-suite'
  - Includes: unit, integration, e2e

If {{testScope}} == 'affected':
  - Run: 'run-affected-tests' 
  - Only tests for changed services

If {{testScope}} == 'smoke':
  - Run: 'run-smoke-tests'
  - Quick validation only

Compose test activities sequentially with results chaining.

variables.name: testScope
variables.description: Test scope: full, affected, or smoke

tasks.description: Deploy to target environment if all checks pass

prompt.template:
Review test results impulse.

If all tests passed:
  Search for deployment activities:
  search_activities({ category: 'infrastructure' })
  
  Execute deployment based on {{targetEnvironment}}:
  
  If 'staging':
    activity({
      templateId: 'deploy-to-staging',
      variables: { version: '{{version}}', services: '<affected>' },
      reason: 'Automated staging deployment after tests pass'
    })
  
  If 'production':
    - Require manual approval impulse
    - Execute: 'deploy-to-production-with-canary'
    - Monitor: 'validate-production-health'

If tests failed:
  - Skip deployment
  - Create failure report impulse
  - Notify team

This implements conditional composition based on results.

tasks.description: Record execution metrics and evolve the pipeline

prompt.template:
Analyze the complete pipeline execution:

1. Calculate metrics:
   - Total duration
   - Total cost
   - Success/failure rate
   - Bottlenecks identified

2. Pattern detection:
   If this pipeline configuration is novel:
     create_activity_goal_seeking({
       goalDescription: 'CI/CD for {{branch}} pattern',
       templateName: 'cicd-{{pattern-name}}',
       category: 'infrastructure',
       variables: { extracted from this execution }
     })
   
   Then register the new template:
     register_activity_template({
       file_path: '<generated-template>',
       validate_before_register: true,
       test_variables: { sample test case }
     })

3. Report to backend:
   - Execution recorded for Thompson sampling
   - Template success rate updated
   - Pipeline evolves automatically

This creates a SELF-IMPROVING CI/CD ENGINE!

contextRequirements.hint: Git diff analysis and affected service detection
Build status and artifacts from affected services
Test execution results and coverage data
Complete pipeline execution metrics for learning

qualityGates: All builds must succeed before testing
All tests must pass before deployment
